summary: Frontend testing of session changes: Hero section desktop layout, Dark/Light mode consistency, unified payment methods, and 2% service fee calculation. ALL TESTS PASSED.
critical_code_review_comments: HeroSection3D.js correctly uses CSS Grid with dir='ltr' on container to force content LEFT for all languages
All transfer pages (LocalTransfer, WesternUnion, MoneyGram) properly use useTheme() hook and isDark for consistent theming
TravelerBooking.js and TermsAndConditions.js properly implement isDark theme
BookingForm.js has unified payment methods (Zain Cash, Mastercard Al-Rafidain, FIB) and NO 2% fee as required
LocalTransfer.js, WesternUnion.js, MoneyGram.js all have 2% service fee calculation working correctly
All payment method dropdowns show the 3 unified options: Zain Cash, Mastercard Al-Rafidain, FIB
context_for_next_testing_agent: All session changes verified working: Hero layout on LEFT for all languages, theme toggle works on all pages, unified payment methods present, 2% fee on transfer pages only (not on Traveler Booking).
